notes_for_editor: Existing record matches the sources (gone, Lincoln County, ground type); no correction needed. Three different 'Goat Peak' entries exist: this Lincoln County site, a Sanders County camp (FFLA 'Camp Abandoned', 47.99852, -115.59466), and Washington towers; the story keeps to the Lincoln site. Only one detail page plus the FFLA list; no removal date anywhere. The Wikipedia citation is only used to point readers to the Washington Goat Peak.
